title: FPI, crude oil, global trends to to steer markets in holiday-shortened week
description:
Stock market movement would depend on trading activity of foreign investors, crude oil prices and global trends in a holiday-shortened week ahead, analysts said.
Equity markets would remain closed on Tuesday for "Prakash Gurpurb Sri Guru Nanak Dev".
"The holiday-shortened week will be influenced by global economic releases, FPI flows and movements in crude oil and the rupee. Domestically, the HSBC Flash India PMI for November, scheduled for Monday, November 23, will provide insights into private-sector activity," Ajit Mishra, SVP -- Research, Religare Broking, said.
Globally, investors will track the US GDP data, and consumer confidence for cues on economic growth, he added.
"Indian equities head into the coming week on a firmer footing, supported by sustained foreign institutional buying, a recovering rupee, softer crude prices and continued strength in banking stocks.
